name: WeKnora
description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.
one_liner: Feeds a company's documents into an AI system that can then answer employee questions accurately, sourced straight from those documents, and keeps a searchable internal wiki updated automatically.
buyer: An operations manager at a mid-size company drowning in scattered internal documentation (policies, SOPs, product docs) who wants a reliable internal Q&A chatbot.
business_use_cases: A company deploys it internally so support staff get instant, sourced answers instead of digging through outdated wikis.
An agency white-labels and resells it as a 'company brain' chatbot product to small and mid-size clients.
A software vendor uses it to auto-generate and keep its own user-facing documentation continuously up to date.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a hosted, managed 'internal knowledge AI' billed per company per month
Charge a one-off fee for setup and document-ingestion integration

steal_this: Stand up a hosted instance this weekend pre-loaded with one local business's documents, and pitch it as their 'instant answers' chatbot subscription.
